verdict.rationale: Base44 is an AI app builder with agents, so plugging in external MCP servers is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence only documents Base44 acting as an MCP server (App MCP, the Base44 MCP server, the Docs MCP server), which is the opposite role. Its agent and Superagent tool connections (Google Workspace, Slack, JSONC tool configs) are never described as MCP client support, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
